How ordering works

No account, no cart to wrestle with. Pick your piece, send your order, pay with the app you already use — we confirm everything with you before anything is made or shipped.

Three simple steps

  1. 1
    Pick your pieceChoose a ready-made hat above, or describe a custom idea in the order builder below.
  2. 2
    Send your orderCopy the order summary and send it to L&J Crafty Creations. We’ll confirm price, details, and timing with you directly.
  3. 3
    Pay & we get to workPay with Cash App, Venmo, or Zelle once your order is confirmed. Shipping is added on top if you need it mailed.
Idea while you browse: chains are removable — order one hat with a chain and swap it between hats, or add a second chain style later for a whole new look.

A mother-daughter craft table

L&J Crafty Creations is Laura Collins and her daughter Jamie White — pressing tees, decorating hats, and making gifts by hand, one piece at a time. Laura brings the heat press and the know-how; Jamie brings the patches, chains, ribbons, and rhinestones. Everything here is finished at their table, not pulled off a shelf.

Because each piece is handmade, small differences are part of the charm — and custom requests are always welcome. If you can dream the saying, colors, or occasion, ask. That’s the best part of shopping small.
